title: Coefficient criterion for the spectral value of a monic polynomial
statement: Let R be a normed division ring and P a monic polynomial over R [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. Write d for its natural degree and let s(P) be the supremum, over n < d, of the real numbers ‖P.coeff n‖^(1/(d-n)), with the other terms zero; this is Mathlib spectralValue P. Then s(P) ≤ 1 if and only if ‖P.coeff n‖ ≤ 1 for every natural number n.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib spectralValue_le_one_iff to the monicity hypothesis. The theorem has exactly the stated hypotheses and conclusion, including the coefficients in and above degree d.
